fn main() {
    let s = "ab"
    print(str_len(&s) * 10)
    let i = 0
    let total = 0
    while i < 3 {
        let t = &s
        total = total + str_len(&t) * 5
        drop t
        i = i + 1
    }
    drop s
    print(total)
}
